import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    pos = 0
    N = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    M = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    Q = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    INF = 10**18
    edges = []
    for _ in range(M):
        a = int(data[pos]) - 1; b = int(data[pos+1]) - 1; c = int(data[pos+2])
        pos += 3
        edges.append((a, b, c))
    queries = []
    closed = [False] * M
    for _ in range(Q):
        t = int(data[pos])
        if t == 1:
            i = int(data[pos+1]) - 1
            pos += 2
            closed[i] = True
            queries.append((1, i, 0))
        else:
            x = int(data[pos+1]) - 1
            y = int(data[pos+2]) - 1
            pos += 3
            queries.append((2, x, y))
    d = np.full((N, N), INF, dtype=np.int64)
    for i in range(N):
        d[i][i] = 0
    for i in range(M):
        if not closed[i]:
            a, b, c = edges[i]
            if c < d[a][b]:
                d[a][b] = c
                d[b][a] = c
    for k in range(N):
        d = np.minimum(d, d[:, k:k+1] + d[k:k+1, :])
        np.minimum(d, INF, out=d)
    ans = [None] * Q
    for idx in range(Q - 1, -1, -1):
        t, p, q = queries[idx]
        if t == 2:
            v = int(d[p][q])
            ans[idx] = str(v) if v < INF else "-1"
        else:
            a, b, c = edges[p]
            col_a = d[:, a].copy()
            col_b = d[:, b].copy()
            # new dist u->v via edge a-b
            via1 = col_a[:, None] + c + col_b[None, :]
            via2 = col_b[:, None] + c + col_a[None, :]
            nd = np.minimum(d, np.minimum(via1, via2))
            np.minimum(nd, INF, out=nd)
            d = nd
    out = [ans[i] for i in range(Q) if queries[i][0] == 2]
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))

        else:
            x = int(data[pos]) - 1; y = int(data[pos + 1]) - 1; pos += 2
            queries.append((2, x, y))

    D = np.full((N, N), INF, dtype=np.int64)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    pos = 0
    N = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    M = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    Q = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    A = [0] * M
    B = [0] * M
    C = [0] * M
    for i in range(M):
        A[i] = int(data[pos]) - 1
        B[i] = int(data[pos + 1]) - 1
        C[i] = int(data[pos + 2])
        pos += 3
    queries = []
    closed = [False] * M
    for _ in range(Q):
        t = int(data[pos])
        if t == 1:
            i = int(data[pos + 1]) - 1
            pos += 2
            closed[i] = True
            queries.append((1, i))
        else:
            x = int(data[pos + 1]) - 1
            y = int(data[pos + 2]) - 1
            pos += 3
            queries.append((2, x, y))

    INF = float('inf')
    d = [[INF] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        d[i][i] = 0
    for i in range(M):
        if not closed[i]:
            a, b, c = A[i], B[i], C[i]
            if c < d[a][b]:
                d[a][b] = c
                d[b][a] = c

    # Floyd-Warshall
    for k in range(N):
        dk = d[k]
        for i in range(N):
            di = d[i]
            dik = di[k]
            if dik == INF:
                continue
            for j in range(N):
                v = dik + dk[j]
                if v < di[j]:
                    di[j] = v

    answers = []
    for q in reversed(queries):
        if q[0] == 2:
            _, x, y = q
            v = d[x][y]
            answers.append(-1 if v == INF else v)
        else:
            i = q[1]
            a, b, c = A[i], B[i], C[i]
            # add edge back
            da = d[a]
            db = d[b]
            # new distances: for all x,y: min(d[x][y], d[x][a]+c+d[b][y], d[x][b]+c+d[a][y])
            # compute column vectors
            col_a = [d[x][a] for x in range(N)]
            col_b = [d[x][b] for x in range(N)]
            for x in range(N):
                dx = d[x]
                xa = col_a[x] + c
                xb = col_b[x] + c
                for y in range(N):
                    v1 = xa + db[y]
                    v2 = xb + da[y]
                    v = dx[y]
                    if v1 < v:
                        v = v1
                    if v2 < v:
                        v = v2
                    dx[y] = v
    answers.reverse()
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, answers)) + ("\n" if answers else ""))
